features.name: mean_distinct_punct_types_per_comment
features.definition: On average, how many distinct punctuation types (!, ?, ., ,, ;, :, parentheses) appear in each counter-argument comment?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads (list of strings). If missing/malformed -> null; if empty list -> null. For each comment string, count how many of these 7 types occur at least once: '!', '?', '.', ',', ';', ':', parentheses (either '(' or ')' counts as the one parentheses type). Each comment value is 0-7. Return the mean across all comments in the list (every comment included, including those with 0). Raw text, no semantic filtering; text may contain outcome announcements.

h0: mean_distinct_punct_types_per_comment has no association with the probability that the OP changed their view (delta).
h1: Higher mean_distinct_punct_types_per_comment is associated with a higher probability that the OP changed their view.
note: Persuasiveness is operationalized as the dataset outcome delta (OP view change). Row-level aggregation (mean per comment of distinct punctuation types among the 7 listed) is an operational assumption; comment length is not controlled, and longer comments naturally have more variety. Parentheses are treated as one type. Raw text may include quotations or outcome announcements; no filtering applied. Association only, not causal.
